Extensions panel, a smoother reader, volume badges on covers, and Linux downloads.

• Extensions have their own page in the sidebar. A new script has to be approved before it runs, and no script can reach your local network.
• Adding a series from a source returns at once; the rest finishes in the background queue.
• Reader: page turns slide (or fade, or stop animating — your choice in reader settings). Double- or middle-click to zoom, ctrl+wheel zooms smoothly, arrow keys pan a zoomed page, and dragging with the mouse turns pages in the reading direction.
• Built volumes show their number on the Kindle cover thumbnail, and page size and quality can be set by hand.
• Kindle: spreads you keep whole now show whole instead of cropped.
• Linux: .deb, .rpm and AppImage downloads.
